headline: CHW @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 3.91 at NYY 5.13, with a projected total of 9.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: CHW moved +0.71 runs while NYY moved +0.36, changing the projected margin by +0.36 runs. The projected total climbed +1.13, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Sean Burke has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Chase Meidroth, Cody Bellinger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jacob Gonzalez, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
